item.title: Repository quality
item.description: This package uses upstream aspect_rules_lint formatting and linting rules to discover Git-tracked files and inspect declared source targets with established tools acquired by Bazel. It does not implement a formatter or linter and does not download tools at runtime. Thin workspace adapters extend the upstream language list with the official Go SDK for module and workspace manifests, StyLua and Selene for Lua, and the existing Prettier XML plugin for Qt .ui and .qrc files.
